end.line: Quillon for Halden Pharma’s clinical contracts team

vo: Halden Pharma's legal team reviews about seven hundred clinical trial agreements a year, with indemnity positions differing by site.
Your indemnity positions for every site are remembered, so each review starts from what legal already agreed.
When a study manager emails the weekly question, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the agreement.
In Word, Quillon redlines each site's draft to your playbook, with every change explained beside it.
Ingrid will walk your team through it on Thursday the nineteenth.
